subject.title: fix(discord): preserve tool updates when progress preview is empty

question: Should Discord progress mode retain fallback block updates until a visible draft has actually begun, then let the preview exclusively own later interim updates?
rationale: The patch implements a reasonable policy, but it intentionally changes the user-facing ownership and timing of Discord progress messages; the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing product/maintainer review.

options.title: Confirm visible-draft handoff
options.body: Accept fallback block replies before a visible preview and suppress them only after the preview has demonstrably started.

options.title: Prefer preview-only mode
options.body: Retain earlier suppression semantics and address empty previews through a different guaranteed-preview strategy instead.

recommendation.title: Confirm visible-draft handoff
recommendation.body: Accept fallback block replies before a visible preview and suppress them only after the preview has demonstrably started.
